findings.title: Materials' 55-point lens gap signals distress
findings.body: Materials sits at the 30th percentile on forward earnings but the 85th on trailing, the widest split in the table. The market is pricing a 112 percent earnings rebound that would justify the compression, yet the forward percentile barely moved this month — analysts are not confirming the recovery.

findings.title: Health Care's forward price is a bet on margins
findings.body: Health Care's forward multiple is at its 97th percentile while the trailing sits at the 76th, a 21-point gap that implies 79 percent earnings growth. That compression is extreme even for a sector at a five-year high, underwriting margin expansion that has not shown up in reported results.

findings.title: Utilities' forward richness clashes with flat growth
findings.body: Utilities trades at the 27th percentile forward but the 2nd percentile trailing, a 25-point gap despite only 4 percent implied earnings growth. The forward multiple is nearly as rich as the trailing one, so the market is paying a premium for a sector with no earnings acceleration in sight.
